title: 第8章 自己撒的谎，含着泪也要编圆！
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
悦耳的彩铃声响起，正在外公家吃晚饭的李清妍拿起手机，看着来电显示上清清楚楚的‘挡箭牌’三个字后，不动声色地接了起来。

    为了应付叔叔婶婶，以及外公外婆的盘问，她不得不想方设法弄到了梁惟石的QQ号码，添加了好友，然后借口询问一位老师的近况与对方闲聊了片刻，并顺理成章地交换了联系方式。

    没办法，自己撒的谎，含着泪也要编圆！

    毕竟是在‘谈恋爱’，她总不能连‘男朋友’考上哪个单位都不清楚吧？

    “喂……李清妍，我梁惟石。你现在说话方便吗？我想请你帮个忙……是这样，我家里有一枚金代古钱币，想找这方面的专家鉴定一下，但我又没什么门路……”

    李清妍一听就明白了，对方一定是奔着她的外公，华大历史学教授，著名鉴宝专家杨国林老同志来的！

    出于对事情穿帮的担忧，她下意识地就要拒绝，但又想到梁惟石作为一块合格的‘挡箭牌’，让她在叔叔婶婶那里名正言顺地拒绝了沈冲的两次邀请，没有功劳也有苦劳。

    更何况大家同学一场，这点儿小忙都不帮，着实不近人情。

    李清妍眼眸一转，望着外公轻声说道：“梁惟石说他有枚古币，想请您帮忙看看对不对！”

    杨国林稍一沉吟，缓缓点了点头：“明天上午我在家，让小梁带上东西过来吧。”

    对杨教授来说，鉴宝不过是举手之劳的小事，‘鉴人’才是重中之重的大事！

    他要借这个机会，亲眼看看外孙女所谓的‘男朋友’，到底是个什么样的人。

    通完电话，李清妍神色如常地继续吃饭，心里却暗自盘算，如何操作才能避免事情败露。

    唉，她总是心太软，心太软，把所有问题都自己扛。

    撒谎总是简单，圆谎太难。

    实在不行，就别再勉强？

    哎算了吧，先这样吧，再想也没有用。

    大不了提前和梁惟石串好口供！

    ……

    第二天上午，梁惟石拎着两瓶好酒，按李清妍给的地址，准时来到了天合小区十二栋楼三零一室。

    看着满头白发精神矍铄的老人，梁惟石恭敬地弯腰问好。

    这一位是鉴宝界的权威，拥有‘政府特殊津贴获得者’，‘故宫博物院研究员’、‘国家文物鉴定委员会副主任委员’……等一系列头衔。
content_en:
A pleasant ringtone rang, and Li Qingyan, who was having dinner at her grandpa's house, picked up her phone, looked at the three words "shield" clearly on the caller ID, and answered the call calmly.

In order to deal with the interrogations from her uncle, aunt, and grandparents, she had to find ways to get Liang Weishi's QQ number, add her as a friend, and then chatted with him for a while on the pretext of asking about the current situation of a teacher, and exchanged contact information naturally.

I have no choice but to make up the lies I told with tears in my eyes!

After all, they were 'in love', so she couldn't possibly not even know which unit her 'boyfriend' was admitted to, right?

"Hello... Li Qingyan, I'm Liang Weishi. Is it easy for you to speak now? I want to ask you for a favor... I have an ancient coin from the Jin Dynasty at home, and I want to find an expert in this field to identify it, but I don't have any connections..."

Li Qingyan understood immediately upon hearing this that the other party must be here for her grandfather, Comrade Yang Guolin, a history professor at the University of Washington and a famous treasure appraisal expert!

Out of concern that things would turn out to be untrue, she subconsciously wanted to refuse, but she thought of Liang Weishi as a qualified 'shield', which allowed her to justifiably reject Shen Chong's two invitations from her uncle and aunt. There was no credit but hard work.

What's more, it's really unkind to not help even though we are classmates.

Li Qingyan turned her eyes, looked at her grandfather and said softly: "Liang Weishi said that he has an ancient coin, and he would like your help to see if it is correct!"

Yang Guolin pondered for a moment and nodded slowly: "I will be at home tomorrow morning. Let Xiaoliang bring something over."

For Professor Yang, appraising treasures is just a trivial matter, while appraising people is the most important thing!

He wanted to take this opportunity to see with his own eyes what kind of person his granddaughter's so-called 'boyfriend' was.

After the phone call, Li Qingyan continued to eat as usual, but she was secretly thinking about how to avoid the incident being revealed.

Alas, she is always too soft-hearted and takes all the problems on herself.

It's always easy to lie, but it's so difficult to tell a lie.

If it really doesn't work, why don't you try harder?

Hey, forget it, let’s do this for now, there’s no point in thinking about it anymore.

The worst thing is to prepare a confession with Liang Weishi in advance!

…

The next morning, Liang Weishi carried two bottles of good wine and arrived at Room 301, Building 12, Tianhe Community on time according to the address given by Li Qingyan.

Looking at the energetic old man with white hair, Liang Weishi bowed respectfully to say hello.

This person is an authority in the world of treasure appraisal, and has a series of titles such as ‘Recipient of Special Government Allowance’, ‘Researcher of the Palace Museum’, ‘Deputy Chairman of the National Cultural Relics Appraisal Committee’… etc.
title_en: Chapter 8 The lies I tell must be made up even with tears in my eyes!
